items.title: The EU’s Canada offer is more mood than reality but it could hint at a future geometry for the bloc

sentences.en: The EU’s Canada offer is more mood than reality but it could hint at a future geometry for the bloc.

sentences.en: While Brussels and Ottawa desire a deeper partnership born of Trump-era volatility, ​the EU has no legal framework to accommodate it Don’t get This Is Europe delivered to your inbox?

sentences.en: Sign up here The EU and Canada, Ursula von der Leyen said last week, “see the world with the same eyes”, with shared stances on everything from AI to the climate crisis, the Ukraine war and the unholy chaos unleashed by the current occupant of the White House (OK, she didn’t actually say that last bit.
sentences.zh: 欧盟和加拿大，乌苏拉·冯德莱恩（ Ursula von der Leyen ）上周表示， “用同样的眼光看世界” ，在人工智能、气候危机、乌克兰战争和当前白宫居住者引发的邪恶混乱等各方面都有共同的立场（好吧，她实际上并没有说最后一点。

sentences.en: But I like to think she almost certainly thought it.)
sentences.zh: 但我想她几乎肯定是这么想的。）

sentences.en: So, the European Commission president went on, Canada should become “the first associate member of the EU”.
sentences.zh: 因此，欧盟委员会主席接着说，加拿大应该成为“欧盟的第一个准成员”。

sentences.en: In the audience, Mark Carney beamed with delight.
sentences.zh: 在观众席上，马克·卡尼（ Mark Carney ）高兴地笑了。

sentences.en: The next day, Canada’s prime minister enthusiastically embraced the idea of an “alliance for the future”, to build “collective resilience” through “deep cooperation”.
sentences.zh: 第二天，加拿大总理热情拥抱“未来联盟”的想法，通过“深度合作”建立“集体韧性”。

items.title: Developers want more efficient software. Here’s what over 1000 GitHub users told us they need.

sentences.en: Developers want more efficient software.
sentences.zh: 开发人员需要更高效的软件。

sentences.en: Here’s what over 1000 GitHub users told us they need.
sentences.zh: 以下是超过1000名GitHub用户告诉我们的需求。

sentences.en: Developers know efficient software matters, but many lack a clear way to find waste, measure an improvement, and make the case for fixing it.
sentences.zh: 开发人员知道高效的软件很重要，但许多人缺乏清晰的方法来寻找浪费，衡量改进，并提出修复的理由。

sentences.en: That is the central finding from a new survey of 1,039 GitHub users conducted by GitHub and the Yale Program on Climate Change Communication.
sentences.zh: 这是GitHub和耶鲁大学气候变化传播计划对1,039名GitHub用户进行的一项新调查的核心发现。

sentences.en: Eight in 10 respondents said they were interested in tools that help them write more energy-efficient code.
sentences.zh: 十分之八的受访者表示，他们对帮助他们编写更节能的代码的工具感兴趣。

sentences.en: Nearly as many wanted best practices for reducing software s environmental footprint, and almost 75% wanted ways to measure the impact of their software or development process.
sentences.zh: 几乎同样多的人希望通过最佳实践来减少软件的环境足迹，近75%的人希望通过各种方式来衡量其软件或开发过程的影响。

sentences.en: There is an opportunity to turn that interest into normal engineering work: identify unnecessary compute, propose a change, test it, and let maintainers decide what ships.
sentences.zh: 有机会将这种兴趣转化为正常的工程工作：识别不必要的计算，提出更改，测试它，并让维护人员决定什么船。

sentences.en: Developers care about climate change and AI s environmental impact The survey, drawn from GitHub monthly active users in the United States, asked about climate change, AI, software efficiency, and the responsibilities of organizations across the technology sector.
sentences.zh: 开发人员关心气候变化和人工智能的环境影响这项调查来自美国的GitHub月度活跃用户，询问了气候变化、人工智能、软件效率以及整个技术领域组织的责任。

sentences.en: The concern was clear: 79% said they were worried about global warming.
sentences.zh: 担忧很明显： 79%的人表示他们担心全球变暖。

sentences.en: 71% said they were concerned about the environmental impact of AI systems, including their energy and water use and carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 71%的受访者表示，他们担心人工智能系统对环境的影响，包括其能源和水的使用以及碳排放。

sentences.en: 75% said it was important that their employer actively work to reduce its environmental impact.
sentences.zh: 75%的受访者表示，雇主积极努力减少其对环境的影响非常重要。

sentences.en: These findings describe the views of survey respondents.
sentences.zh: 这些调查结果描述了调查受访者的观点。

items.title: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby

sentences.en: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby.
sentences.zh: 德尔西·罗德里格斯（ Delcy Rodríguez ）在纽约与特朗普合影，马杜罗（ Maduro ）在附近的监

sentences.en: Venezuela’s interim president hails ‘historic meeting’ and does not say whether she will visit snatched predecessor Venezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has celebrated a “historic” meeting with Donald Trump in New York, posing for a smiley photo with the US president, less than nine months after he ordered the abduction of her boss, Nicolás Maduro.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉临时总统对“历史性会晤”表示欢迎，但没有说明她是否会访问被抢走的前任委内瑞拉临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯（ Delcy Rodríguez ） ，他在下令绑架她的老板尼古拉斯·马杜罗（ Nicolás Maduro ）不到九个月后，在纽约庆祝了与唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）的“历史性”会晤，与美国总统合影留念。

sentences.en: The former foes met at a five-star hotel a few blocks from Trump Tower in Manhattan late on Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN general assembly.
sentences.zh: 周二晚些时候，在联合国大会期间，这些前敌人在距离曼哈顿特朗普大厦几个街区的一家五星级酒店相遇。

sentences.en: The hotel is about 7 miles from the Brooklyn prison where Maduro has been held since he was snatched during a special forces raid on Caracas in January.
sentences.zh: 这家酒店距离布鲁克林监狱约7英里，马杜罗自1月份在加拉加斯的一次特种部队袭击中被抢走以来一直被关押在那里。

items.title: UN’s ‘sacred covenant has been broken’, Argentina’s Milei tells General Assembly

sentences.en: UN’s ‘sacred covenant has been broken’, Argentina’s Milei tells General Assembly.

items.title: LIVE: Climate change is here - What happens next is still in our hands

sentences.en: LIVE: Climate change is here - What happens next is still in our hands.
sentences.zh: 现场直播：气候变化就在这里-接下来会发生什么仍然掌握在我们手中。

sentences.en: From deadly floods in the Himalayas to wildfires and extreme heat across Europe, 2026 has brought a succession of stark reminders of a changing climate.
sentences.zh: 从喜马拉雅山的致命洪水到欧洲各地的野火和极端高温， 2026年带来了一系列关于气候变化的严酷提醒。

sentences.en: The task is immediate: Protect people from the impacts already unfolding while rapidly cutting the emissions of harmful gasses driving climate change.
sentences.zh: 当务之急是：保护人们免受已经发生的影响，同时迅速减少导致气候变化的有害气体排放。

sentences.en: World leaders have been meeting on Wednesday to discuss how to turn those priorities into action.
sentences.zh: 世界各国领导人周三举行会议，讨论如何将这些优先事项转化为行动。

items.title: LIVE: OpenAI and Anthropic brief Security Council amid ‘real and imminent’ threat posed by runaway AI

sentences.en: LIVE: OpenAI and Anthropic brief Security Council amid ‘real and imminent’ threat posed by runaway AI.
sentences.zh: 现场：在失控的人工智能构成的“真实和迫在眉睫”威胁之下， OpenAI和人类简报安全理事会。

sentences.en: The Security Council has been briefed by some of the world's top AI executives on the huge benefits and huge risks the frontier technology presents.
sentences.zh: 一些世界顶级人工智能高管向安理会简要介绍了前沿技术带来的巨大好处和巨大风险。

sentences.en: With warnings mounting that the world may be losing its grip on systems built to outthink us, Yoshua Bengi, a recipient of the prestigious Turing Award and one of the godfathers of machine intelligence, said the dangers of AI beyond human control represent an unprecedented threat for countries “that none can contain alone and that does not respect the borders we defend.”
sentences.zh: 著名的图灵奖获得者、机器智能教父之一约书亚·本吉（ Yoshua Bengi ）警告说，随着世界可能正在失去对超越我们的系统的控制，人工智能超越人类控制的危险对国家构成了前所未有的威胁， “没有人可以单独遏制，也不尊重我们捍卫的边界。”

items.title: Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine

sentences.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for intensified pressure on Russia to end its war against Ukraine, arguing that Moscow continues to incur massive losses while prolonging a conflict whose consequences are increasingly being felt far beyond the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelenskyy ）周三呼吁加大对俄罗斯的压力，以结束其对乌克兰的战争，他认为莫斯科继续遭受巨大损失，同时延长冲突，其后果越来越远离战场。

items.title: Rohingya refugees deserve a future beyond survival, not endless displacement

sentences.en: Rohingya refugees deserve a future beyond survival, not endless displacement.
sentences.zh: 罗兴亚难民应该有一个超越生存的未来，而不是无休止的流离失所。

sentences.en: Nine years after the mass displacement of the Rohingya from Myanmar, their situation remains one of the world's most protracted and complex refugee crises, marked by years of persecution and uncertainty over the prospect of returning home.
sentences.zh: 罗兴亚人从缅甸大规模流离失所九年后，他们的处境仍然是世界上最旷日持久和复杂的难民危机之一，其特点是多年的迫害和对返回家园前景的不确定性。

items.title: Guterres calls on countries to set clear timelines for transition away from fossil fuels

sentences.en: Guterres calls on countries to set clear timelines for transition away from fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 古特雷斯呼吁各国为摆脱化石燃料制定明确的时间表。

sentences.en: “We are the first generation with the tools to end the fossil fuel age – and the last who can avert climate catastrophe,” UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Wednesday, calling on countries to draw up credible roadmaps with clear timelines to transition away from fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（ António Guterres ）周三表示： “我们是拥有结束化石燃料时代工具的第一代人，也是能够避免气候灾难的最后一代人。”他呼吁各国制定可信的路线图，并制定明确的时间表，以摆脱化石燃料。

items.title: Equality ‘ends at the doors of the Security Council’, Kenya’s Ruto tells General Assembly

sentences.en: Kenyan President William Ruto told the General Assembly on Wednesday that the sovereign equality the UN proclaims is contradicted by its own structures, urging Member States to reform the Security Council and an international financial system “built for another age”.

items.title: Introducing Amazon CloudWatch Omni: collaborative AI-powered observability for your applications

sentences.en: Introducing Amazon CloudWatch Omni: collaborative AI-powered observability for your applications.
sentences.zh: 隆重推出Amazon CloudWatch Omni ：面向应用的协作式人工智能可观测性。

sentences.en: Amazon CloudWatch now offers CloudWatch Omni, an AI-powered observability experience for the applications and AI agents you run together.
sentences.zh: Amazon CloudWatch现在为您一起运行的应用程序和人工智能代理提供CloudWatch Omni ，这是一种基于人工智能的可观察性体验。

sentences.en: You reach Omni through a dedicated URL for your organization and sign in with the identities you already manage, so working in Omni does not require access to the AWS Management Console.
sentences.zh: 您可以通过组织的专用URL访问Omni ，并使用已管理的身份登录，因此在Omni中工作不需要访问AWS管理控制台。

sentences.en: Omni is built on OpenTelemetry: the telemetry you already send to CloudWatch appears in Omni with nothing to reconfigure, and any other workload you instrument with OpenTelemetry sends its telemetry to an OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) endpoint.
sentences.zh: Omni基于OpenTelemetry构建：您已经发送到CloudWatch的遥测显示在Omni中，无需重新配置，您使用OpenTelemetry检测的任何其他工作负载都会将其遥测发送到OpenTelemetry协议(OTLP)端点。

sentences.en: CloudWatch Omni offers both agent observability and application observability in a single experience.
sentences.zh: CloudWatch Omni在单一体验中提供代理可观察性和应用可观察性。

sentences.en: In our companion post , we introduced the agent observability capabilities of Omni for generative AI and agentic workloads.
sentences.zh: 在我们的配套帖子中，我们介绍了Omni针对生成式人工智能和代理工作负载的代理可观察性功能。

sentences.en: In this post, we present the application observability experience.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将介绍应用程序可观察性体验。

sentences.en: Engineering teams spend a significant portion of their observability time maintaining dashboards, tuning thresholds, and switching between tools to piece together what happened during an incident.
sentences.zh: 工程团队花费大量时间维护仪表板、调整阈值以及在工具之间切换，以拼凑事件期间发生的事情。

sentences.en: When an issue crosses team boundaries, context gets lost in Slack threads and screenshots rather than flowing naturally to the next engineer.
sentences.zh: 当问题跨越团队界限时，上下文会丢失在Slack线程和屏幕截图中，而不是自然地流向下一位工程师。

sentences.en: CloudWatch Omni changes this by organizing observability around your applications rather than individual signals, and bringing your whole team into the same workspace.
sentences.zh: CloudWatch Omni通过围绕您的应用程序而不是单个信号组织可观察性来改变这一点，并将您的整个团队带入同一个工作区。

sentences.en: What CloudWatch Omni brings CloudWatch Omni addresses three problems that engineering teams told us they face today.
sentences.zh: CloudWatch Omni带来的CloudWatch Omni解决了工程团队告诉我们他们今天面临的三个问题。

sentences.en: One collaborative experience for your whole team.
sentences.zh: 为您的整个团队提供一次协作体验。

items.title: Introducing Amazon CloudWatch Omni: AI-powered observability for generative AI and agentic workloads

sentences.en: Introducing Amazon CloudWatch Omni: AI-powered observability for generative AI and agentic workloads.
sentences.zh: 隆重推出Amazon CloudWatch Omni ：基于AI的可观察性，适用于生成式AI和代理工作负载。

sentences.en: Today, Amazon CloudWatch introduces CloudWatch Omni, a unified observability experience for application and AI workloads that is app-centric, AI-powered, built on open standards, and delivered off-console.
sentences.zh: 今天， Amazon CloudWatch推出了CloudWatch Omni ，这是一种针对应用程序和人工智能工作负载的统一可观察性体验，以应用程序为中心，以人工智能为动力，基于开放标准构建，并在控制台外提供。

sentences.en: CloudWatch Omni is a purpose-built observability, evaluation, and experimentation solution for AI agents.

It helps teams design, evaluate, and operate AI agents across any model provider, framework, or runtime, with an eval-driven workflow, support for the tools you already use, and observability delivered where you work: directly in your IDE and through a standalone web experience, separate from the AWS Management Console.
Organizations deploying agentic AI systems face observability challenges that traditional monitoring can’t address.
Agent behavior is non-deterministic: a prompt change can degrade response quality even when standard metrics show no errors.
Teams spend hours manually reviewing logs across multiple systems, unable to pinpoint what changed or why.

Existing tools force teams to choose between siloed generative AI monitoring or fragmented solutions requiring constant context-switching between their coding environment and browser-based dashboards.
CloudWatch Omni captures every trace and includes built-in evaluators for correctness, coherence, retrieval quality, and tool selection, among others.
You can compare prompt versions side by side in the playground, build test datasets from production traffic, run experiments across different configurations, and detect regressions automatically.
Two surfaces for development and operations CloudWatch Omni delivers observability through two complementary surfaces.
Developers get a native extension inside VS Code and Kiro (the currently supported IDEs), where traces appear as you run your agent with a playground and evaluators a click away.

items.title: Spotlight on SIG Apps

sentences.en: Spotlight on SIG Apps.
As Kubernetes adoption has grown, the conversation has shifted beyond running containers to managing increasingly complex application lifecycles.
Modern platforms support stateless web services, stateful databases, batch processing, AI workloads, and platform services.
At the same time, they must remain reliable during upgrades, scaling events, and infrastructure failures.
Every Kubernetes user relies on SIG Apps, whether they realize it or not.
Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs, and CronJobs form the foundation of how applications are deployed, updated, scaled, and operated across the Kubernetes ecosystem.

SIG Apps is focused on improving workload resilience, refining application lifecycle management, and addressing the operational challenges that emerge when applications encounter node failures, rollout disruptions, and increasingly complex infrastructure environments.

In this spotlight, we sit down with two of the three SIG Apps chairs Janet Kuo and Maciej Szulik to discuss the evolution of Kubernetes workload management, the challenges of balancing application reliability with operational simplicity, and the future of application lifecycle management within one of Kubernetes’ most influential Special Interest Groups.
Introducing SIG Apps Natalie Fisher: Can you introduce yourself, your role, and how you got involved in SIG Apps?
Janet Kuo: I'm a Senior Staff Software Engineer at Google and have been a Kubernetes maintainer since 2015, joining the community just as we were racing toward the 1.0 launch.

In those early days, my focus was on building the core Workloads API, specifically developing controllers like Deployment, ReplicaSet, StatefulSet, and DaemonSet, defining their rollout behaviors, and bringing them from initial designs to GA.
That hands-on work was my entry point into SIG Apps.
